translation.name: Xchiʼdxyi cuubi dxiohs nin bieʼgaluuʼyi daada Jesucristu (El Nuevo Testamento en el zapoteco de Chichicapan y en español)

book.name: San Mateo
book.title: Dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ riiꞌ nin bacaꞌh San Mateu xcweenta Jesucristu

content: Chin babahn Jesuhs loh guelguhchi
Chin gudiiꞌdxi dxyih nin ruziꞌlaaꞌdzi raꞌ bwiinn Israel, rsiiyidoꞌ mwer dxyih nin rzoꞌbaloh xmahn gwaguiaꞌha María Magdalena cun stuhbi María rwaaꞌ baꞌ hasta bigaꞌtsi Jesuhs,

per laꞌtuhbi lluh rooꞌ guhcala hohrachi laasii hohra chi biehta tuhbi xaanjla Dxiohs nez llaaꞌndxibaaꞌ, ya badzihn aanjla chi rwaaꞌ baꞌ chi chiꞌchi gudooꞌba aanjla chi dxiah nin ñieꞌw rwaaꞌ baꞌ, chiꞌchi guzohba ba yihcan.
Xñah ba ziga zi tuhbi duꞌh guziꞌw, ya xahba ba xñah labwehtiiꞌ zigazi guiiꞌga,
ya chin bwaꞌha raꞌ suldahdu nin riiyahpa rwaaꞌ baꞌ chi loh aanjla chi bidxyihbi duxa raꞌ ba hasta biaꞌhan raꞌ ba ziga zi bwiinn guuchi raꞌ,
ya chiꞌchi guñiꞌ aanjla chi loh raꞌ gunnaꞌh chi rahbi ba: ―Ayi guidxyihbi tu, naꞌh laꞌn guhcabwaꞌ rii gadxiꞌhyi tu laꞌh Jesuhs, nin guhchi loh cruhzi.
Ayi Ñiꞌh rii laꞌh Ñiꞌh babahn loh guelguhchi ziga gahca guñiꞌ Ñiꞌh. Nicala gultaaꞌguiaꞌha hasta bigaꞌtsi Ñiꞌh ayi la Ñiꞌh.

Guldxiaa nnahpaꞌh tin gulgahbi loh raꞌ xpwiinn Jesuhs laꞌh Ñiꞌh babahn loh guelguhchi, ya galoh ru Ñiꞌh guzee Ñiꞌh nez guihdxyi raꞌ xteenn Galilea que laꞌhtu; ya riꞌchi zwaꞌha tu loh Ñiꞌh; pwihsi deeꞌ naa dxyiꞌdxyi nin nahpa guiñiꞌn loh tu.
Ya chiꞌchi ziaa raꞌ gunnaꞌh raꞌ chi carrih neezaa tuhbiꞌtuꞌhn bidxyihbi raꞌ ba cun neezaa riahxi duxa raꞌ ba tin gwaguihtsi galluꞌn raꞌ ba loh raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh laꞌh Ñiꞌh nabahan,

ya hohra chi gahca baluuꞌyiloh Jesuhs loh raꞌ gunnaꞌh raꞌ chi, chiꞌchi bagahpaDxiohs Ñiꞌh laꞌh raꞌ ba, ya gwabiiga raꞌ gunnaꞌh chi hasta zuu Jesuhs gudiꞌdzi raꞌ ba ñaaꞌ Ñiꞌh bazuꞌnllihbi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh,
chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Ayi guidxyihbi tu; gulcheguihtsi loh raꞌ bwiitsi raꞌn guzee raꞌ ba nez Galilea ya riꞌchi zwaꞌha raꞌ ba loon.
Dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin bwiiꞌyidxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ bwiinn nin gohpa rwaaꞌ baꞌ

Ya gaduhbi ziaa raꞌ gunnaꞌh raꞌ chi, gubiaꞌgarii raꞌ za paaldaa suldahdu raꞌ loh guihdxyi Jerusalehn tin gwaguihtsi raꞌ ba loh raꞌ bixohza raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ laꞌh raꞌ bixohza garaa raꞌ nin bwaꞌha raꞌ ba guhca rwaaꞌ baꞌ.

Hohr chi gwah raꞌ bixohza raꞌ chi gwagañiꞌ raꞌ ba loh raꞌ bwiinn guuhla raꞌ xteenn bwiinn Israel raꞌ tin biaꞌhan dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba xa guunn raꞌ ba, ya chiꞌchi badiꞌhi raꞌ ba mweeyi rooꞌ laꞌh raꞌ suldahdu raꞌ chi
ya rahbi raꞌ ba loh raꞌ suldahdu raꞌ chi: ―Squiiꞌ gulgahbi loh raꞌ bwiinn: “Bwiinn raꞌ nin naa raꞌ xpwiinn Jesuhs bieꞌgaleꞌhe bweꞌltihxi Jesuhs gaduhbi nin naꞌxgahsi nu”,
ya sidela laꞌh dxyiꞌdxyi gariaꞌca loh Pilahtu, laꞌh nu gachiñiꞌ nu loh ba ayi xi lligaaba guunn tu zachizuꞌhnee nu laꞌh tu.

Ya chiꞌchi gucaꞌha raꞌ suldahdu raꞌ chi mweeyi, ya bwiꞌhnn raꞌ ba ziga guhdzi raꞌ bwiinn chi loh raꞌ ba, ya ziga bachiꞌhyi raꞌ ba laꞌh raꞌ suldahdu guiñiꞌ raꞌ ba ziꞌchi za rñiꞌ raꞌ bwiinn Israel raꞌ hasta nnadxyih.
Dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin bacaꞌbi Jesuhs laꞌh raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh
Pwihsi gunaꞌzu nehza gadziꞌh bituhbi raꞌ xpwiinn Jesuhs tin gwah raꞌ ba nez guihdxyi Galilea, loh dahan nin guhdzi Jesuhs gadxaꞌga raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh,
ya chin bwaꞌha raꞌ ba loh Jesuhs, bazuꞌnllihbi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh nicala spaaldaa raꞌ ba ayi riachiistoꞌ raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh,
ya chiꞌchi gwabiiga Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba tin rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Naꞌh lanaꞌpaa garaatiiꞌ guelrnabwaꞌ llaaꞌndxibaaꞌ cun loh guidxyiyuh,

niꞌchin nnah gulchehnee xchiꞌdxyiꞌhn loh garaa raꞌ bwiinn guidxyiyuh tin gulguiꞌhn laꞌh raꞌ ba xpwiinn raꞌn cun gulgaroꞌbañihsa laꞌh raꞌ ba pur lah Daada Dxiohs cun lah Lliiꞌn Ñiꞌh, cun lah Spíritu Santu,

nee gulgaluuꞌyi laꞌh raꞌ ba guzoꞌbadxiahga raꞌ ba garaa raꞌ dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin gunaꞌbwaꞌn loh tu, nee gulgacabwaꞌ za naꞌh laꞌn zuꞌnee laꞌh tu hasta chin gadzihn dxyih nin gaduhbi guidxyiyuh. Pwihsi guyaꞌloh dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin bacaꞌh San Mateu pur Jesucristu. Ziꞌchi gaca pwihsi.
